card.name: Opening capsules in preparation steps
card.fires_on: The word Open at the start of a sentence telling the reader to open a capsule, packet or syringe, right after food or liquid is set out. It also fires on "of" in "contents of" a packet or capsule.

modes.label: Open the capsule
modes.description: Sentence-initial Open before capsule, packet, shell or syringe, after setting out applesauce, juice or a container.
modes.example: into a clean container.<< Open>> the capsule. Sprinkle the entire contents

modes.label: Contents of a unit
modes.description: The word of after "contents" when adding a packet or capsule's contents to liquid.
modes.example: Add the entire contents<< of>> one unit-dose packet of NUZ

card.writes: It pushes toward words about packaging and containers, such as packaged, packages, cartridges and kit.
card.plain: It marks the step in mixing instructions where you open the capsule or packet and empty it out.
